HA LEYLİM / _OH MY NOCTURNAL ONE_

Baş koydum senle aşkın yastığına / _I placed my head on the pillow of love with you_ 
Aşkolsun gelme görmezden / _I plead with you, don’t overlook me_
Yangın var bende söndürüver bari / _There’s a fire burning in me, won’t you put it out_
Bir rüzgar esti körfezden / _A wind just blew in from the bay_

Alsam versem de düşse bu süngü / _Let me take and let me give, so I can lower my guard_
O ağzında bir güneşlensem / _If only I could sunbathe in that mouth of yours_ 
Çektim çoktan kapılarına sürgüyü / _It’s been a long time since I have bolted your doors_
Ya teslim ol ya güreş benlen / _Either surrender or wrestle with me_

Kaptırdım seline, kandım meçhulüne / _I’m caught up in your flood, fooled by your unknown quality_
Sayende ağaç oldum burda / _Thanks to you I’m kicking my heels here_
Sokağında caddende / _On your side street, on your main street_
Sabrımın da sonu var biline / _May it be known there’s an end to my patience_
Kızgın demir hep avucumda / _The searing iron is always in my palm_
Darlandı müneccimler / _All the fortune-tellers are in distress_
Gel kurtar oku değdir kalbime / _Come rescue the arrow make it strike my heart_ 
Çabuk, haydi çabuk / _Rush, come on and rush_

Ha leylim bi’ ses ver be güzelim / _Oh my nocturnal one, call out to me, my beautiful one_ 
Bu gece bana gel şeker ezelim / _Come to me tonight, let’s crush our sweet crush_
Yaradan duysun da, muradımı versin de / _May God hear me, and grant me my wish_ 
Yaz maz gelsin gezinelim / _Let summer come so we can wander together_

Garibim, keşkem ve helalim / _My peculiar one, my wish, my rightful one_
Dola sen boynuma vebalin’ / _Embrace me, may its sin be on me_
Nişanımız olsun da, tüm kasaba bilsin de / _Let’s get engaged, and let the whole town know_
Sağ elinde dursun sol elim, sol elim / _Let me place my left hand, my left hand, in your right hand_
(Muhabbet bağında yüzelim) / _(Let’s wade in the orchard of affection)_
